title: Proper and open factors of the coefficient square
statement: Proper and open factors of the coefficient square. These are the actual functors and ordered comparisons of the concrete finite-reduction square, with normalized scalar adjunctions and tensor models [def-sp-open-scalar-tensor-data] and compact-support coefficient data [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. These factors use the fixed constant coefficient system and tensor input [def-sf-concrete-projection-reduction-data].

source.place: Tags 07A4, 07A6, 0D6D, 0E48; more-etale.tex Tags 0GL1 and 0GL6. Concrete proper/open argument of fix-prop-projection-formula, proof sentence 2.

proof.text: Name the actual proper and open functors, scalar mates and counit-defined proper projection. The open factor includes the geometric pullback compositor of the chosen compactification. No comparison is chosen anew.

proof_origin.place: Concrete finite coefficient-reduction square, proof sentence 2; the component argument recorded above.

mathlib_searches.query: Derived pullback and extension of scalar coefficients commute with tensor product and adjunction counit projection formula
mathlib_searches.results: Ordinary ModuleCat unit/counit and Presheaf.pullbackComp hits; no normalized unbounded constant-ring proper/open square.
Eleven generic adjunction APIs; use Hom-equivalence naturality and mate equations.

mathlib_searches.results: One unrelated CStarProjection hit. Local rg located normalized scalar tensor, proper/open and compact-support comparisons used here.

from.place: Normalized concrete proper/open coefficient square, its components and coefficient cocycles.

lean.statement:
def openFactor (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (c : Compactification f) (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A)
    (L : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y A) :
    input m A c.g ((openImage A c.i).obj K) L ≅
      (openImage A c.i).obj (input m A f K L)
